Intro : The whole example is based  in the use case scenario:  Use Case [8]: Insert Courier ranges


## UI

In order to insert courier ranges we had to add a new pop up window to an already existing screen.

Existing screen : Delivery supplier code

New pop - up window: Add the range numbers for the courier Range numbers ( )

The path for code is: pwc-ui\src\app\parameters\issuing\product\delivery-supplier-code. In Visual Studio this was the file structure delivery supplier code before adding new functionalities:


The files represent the following:
- tests folder = unit tests
- view folder = the html and typescript files required for the screens
- vo (value object) folder = the entity component
- deliverySupplierCode.config.ts file  = configuration file
- deliverySupplierCode.module.ts file = angular module class


So, for the implementation of courier ranges was needed:  an additional entity in folder and two more files in  'popups' folder. VO

Since the screen was already in place, we have to add the path of the URL which is mapped on the <module_name>.routes.ts file. For example, in didn't our case in  issuing.routes.ts  file the:

{ path: 'delivery-supplier-code', loadChildren: './product/delivery-supplier-code/deliverySupplierCode.module#DeliverySupplierCodeModule' } was already included.
